meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打磨界面细节,让组件、动效与交互手感更自然精致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正为产品的界面细节和交互质感反复推敲
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep refining your product's interface details and interaction feel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Emil Kowalski 的设计工程理念帮你写界面、审界面代码;审代码时固定用 Before/After/Why 表格逐条指出动效、缓动、时长上的问题。
howto.when: 当你让它审查或改进界面组件代码、讨论动画缓动与时长,或第一次调用这个技能时接管。

say.text: 帮我审一下这个按钮的下压反馈和 transition
这个下拉菜单该用多长动画、什么缓动?
say.note: 按出现频率和进出场给建议

say.text: 弹窗该从中心缩放还是从触发元素缩放?
say.note: 会说明 popover 与 modal 的区别

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes and reviews UI code using Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy, and reviews UI code in a fixed Before/After/Why table covering animation, easing and duration.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask Claude to review or improve interface component code, discuss animation easing or duration, or first invoke the skill.

say_en.text: Review this button's press feedback and transition
How long should this dropdown animate, and with what easing?
say_en.note: Advice based on frequency and enter/exit

say_en.text: Should this popover scale from center or its trigger?
